# scraper-mcp — Full Documentation

## Overview
scraper-mcp is a FastMCP 3.2 fleet server that monitors MCP repo grades
across ToolBench (Arcade.dev), Glama.ai, and LobeHub Marketplace.
Replaces deprecated toolbench-mcp.

## Ports
- Backend (FastAPI + FastMCP HTTP): 10998
- Frontend (Vite + React): 10999

## Quick Start
```powershell
git clone https://github.com/sandraschi/scraper-mcp
cd scraper-mcp
uv sync
.\start.ps1
```

## MCP Tools

| Tool | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| scraper_refresh | MUTATING | Refresh grades across all platforms |
| scraper_matrix | READ_ONLY | Coverage matrix: repos x platforms with grades |
| scraper_repo | READ_ONLY | Single-repo grade detail + history |
| scraper_reassess | MUTATING | Request rescoring on platforms |
| scraper_improve_suggest | MUTATING | LLM-powered code fix suggestions |
| scraper_improvement_plan | READ_ONLY | Prioritized fix list from ToolBench findings |
| scraper_status | READ_ONLY | Server health, last refresh, platform status |
| scraper_help | READ_ONLY | Multi-level help |
| scraper_platforms | READ_ONLY | List/info grade platforms |
| scraper_shutdown | DESTRUCTIVE | Graceful server shutdown |
| toolbench_guide | READ_ONLY | ToolBench context, links, rescoring steps |
| show_matrix_card | READ_ONLY | Prefab card: coverage matrix |
| show_status_card | READ_ONLY | Prefab card: platform health |

## REST Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| /health | GET | Liveness probe |
| /api/capabilities | GET | Server capabilities |
| /api/tools | GET | Registered MCP tools |
| /api/apps | GET | Fleet apps hub |
| /api/status | GET | Server status, uptime, grade counts |
| /api/coverage | GET | Coverage matrix for fleet repos |
| /api/coverage/{repo} | GET | Single-repo grade detail |
| /api/trends | GET | Grade direction (+/-/=) per repo per platform |
| /api/refresh | POST | Trigger grade refresh |
| /api/export | GET | Export all grades as JSON |
| /api/badge.svg | GET | SVG score badge for a repo |
| /api/llm/providers | GET | Local LLM (Ollama) detection |
| /api/llm/chat | POST | Chat with local LLM |
| /api/meta/tools | GET | MCP tool metadata |
| /api/meta/local-llm | GET | Local LLM probe (Ollama + LM Studio) |
| /api/logs | GET | Activity logs |
| /api/scraper/{action} | GET/POST | ToolBench Playwright archiver |
| /api/skills | GET | List available skills |
| /api/skills/{name} | GET | Get skill SKILL.md content |

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| SCRAPER_MCP_HOST | 127.0.0.1 | Bind address |
| SCRAPER_MCP_PORT | 10998 | Backend port |
| SCRAPER_MCP_WEBAPP_PORT | 10999 | Frontend port |
| LLM_GATEWAY_URL | http://127.0.0.1:10916 | LLM gateway for AI suggestions |
| LLM_GATEWAY_PROVIDER | — | Gateway provider |
| LLM_GATEWAY_MODEL | — | Gateway model |
| AIWATCHER_URL | http://127.0.0.1:10946 | AI watcher for grade drop alerts |
| SCRAPER_ALERT_THRESHOLD | B | Alert threshold grade |

## Architecture

```
webapp (Vite React, :10999)
  └── /api/* ──► backend (FastAPI + FastMCP, :10998)
                    ├── /mcp ──► FastMCP Streamable HTTP
                    ├── /api/coverage ──► analytics.get_coverage_matrix()
                    ├── /api/refresh ──► scrapers.engine.refresh_all()
                    └── /api/scraper ──► Playwright ToolBench archiver

platforms/
  toolbench.arcade.dev  — scraper using httpx + HTML parsing
  glama.ai              — scraper using httpx + HTML parsing
  lobehub.com           — scraper using httpx + JSON API
```

## Data
- SQLite at `data/scraper_mcp/grades.db`
- Tables: grades (current), grade_history (deltas)
